description: This file is the entry point for a React web application. It imports React libraries, CSS styling, and the main App component, then initializes and renders the App component into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering, targeting the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree within the root element, wrapping it in React.StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.
